Interface IsotopeFactory

All Known Implementing Classes:
Isotopes, XMLIsotopeFactory
public interface IsotopeFactory
An interface for working with an isotope catalog. The classes Isotopes extends this class and is to be used to get isotope information.
At a minimum the #isotopes() method should be implemented, and ideally provide either immutable or a copy of the internal data. For performance reasons you should also implement the #isotopes(int), #getMajorIsotope and #getNaturalMass - note the defaults are provided but perform a linear scan the entire catalog.
Author:
Christoph steinbeck, John Mayfield

    • getMajorIsotope

      default IIsotope getMajorIsotope(int elem)
      Returns the most abundant (major) isotope with a given atomic number. Note that some high mass elements do not have a major isotopes (0% abundance) and this method will return null for those.
      Parameters:
      elem - The atomicNumber for which an isotope is to be returned
      Returns:
      The isotope corresponding to the given atomic number
      See Also:
      • getMajorIsotope(String symbol)
